stemMd:
A town says its repair backlog grew despite increased repair activity.

| Month | New faults reported | Faults repaired |
|---|---:|---:|
| April | 60 | 45 |
| May | 85 | 65 |

Which statement best supports the town's claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Repairs increased from 45 to 65, but new reports exceeded repairs in both months.

options.label: B
options.textMd: May had fewer new faults than April.

options.label: C
options.textMd: All reported faults were repaired in May.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The backlog must have fallen by 20 in May.

explanationMd: Backlog changes by additions minus completions. The repair count rose, but each month still added more faults than were removed, so the stock of unresolved faults increased.

distractorRationale.d: The difference 85−65 adds 20 to the backlog.
distractorRationale.c: Only 65 of 85 new reports were matched by repairs, before considering prior backlog.
